note: Where to find each known sensor/board manufacturer's full product catalog. Built by 5 area agents. best_ingest_path = how to bulk-pull into the parts pool. Sipeed added 2026-10-04.

manufacturers.catalog_source: https://www.adafruit.com/products (paginated product list); category tree at https://www.adafruit.com/category
manufacturers.access_notes: Open-source-hardware store. Product pages carry full specs; most designs are on github.com/adafruit. No official public product REST API, but the product list and category pages are fully scrapable and stable. Adafruit is a Mouser line (Feather, QT Py, breakout boards).
manufacturers.best_ingest_path: Mouser pull (DONE: 97 Adafruit parts staged) for Feather/QT Py/breakouts; supplement via store category scrape for the full catalog.

manufacturers.access_notes: Module maker: WiFi (ESP-01/ESP-12/ESP32 modules), BLE, LoRa (Ra-01/Ra-02), GPRS/GPS, Zigbee, NB-IoT, camera. English site product pages + docs.ai-thinker.com datasheets. Modules sometimes appear on Mouser/LCSC via distributors but Ai-Thinker is not a first-party Mouser line — treat store/docs as primary.
manufacturers.best_ingest_path: Scrape en.ai-thinker.com product pages + docs.ai-thinker.com datasheets. LCSC is the cleanest distributor source if needed; not reliably on Mouser.

manufacturers.catalog_source: https://store.arduino.cc/collections/boards (store board collections); hardware specs at github.com/arduino + docs.arduino.cc
manufacturers.access_notes: Store (Shopify-style collections) lists official boards (UNO R4, Nano, Portenta, Giga, MKR, Nicla). Board specs/pinouts at docs.arduino.cc. Arduino is a Mouser line.
manufacturers.best_ingest_path: Mouser pull for official Arduino board SKUs; supplement specs from docs.arduino.cc per-board pages.

manufacturers.best_ingest_path: Mouser pull for Gravity/FireBeetle/Beetle SKUs; scrape store category pages for LattePanda and boards not on Mouser.

manufacturers.best_ingest_path: Scrape store category pages. Not on Mouser.

Espressif modules (ESP32-WROOM/WROVER/C3/S3 etc.) are stocked on Mouser.
manufacturers.best_ingest_path: Mouser pull (DONE: 99 Espressif parts staged) for the module/DevKit SKUs; supplement chip-level specs from the product-selector JSON backend.

manufacturers.access_notes: NanoPi SBCs (R-series routers, NEO, M-series), CM modules, NanoPC. OpenCart store with category routes. Wiki documents each board. NOT a Mouser line — scrape store + wiki.
manufacturers.best_ingest_path: Scrape friendlyelec.com OpenCart category pages + wiki.friendlyelec.com specs. Not on Mouser.

manufacturers.access_notes: ODROID SBCs (M1/M1S/M2/N2+/H3+/C4/XU4), displays, accessories. Wiki at wiki.odroid.com. Small stable catalog. NOT a Mouser line — scrape store.
manufacturers.best_ingest_path: Scrape hardkernel.com store category pages + wiki.odroid.com for specs. Not on Mouser.

manufacturers.access_notes: Module maker: AC-DC/DC-DC power modules (HLK-PM01 etc.), WiFi/router modules (HLK-7628N, RM65), BLE (B35), mmWave radar (LD2410/LD2420/LD2450/LD2451), voice, face-recognition. manufacturers.catalog_source: https://ark.intel.com (ARK spec database for processors); dev kits/Movidius under intel.com products
manufacturers.access_notes: ARK is a comprehensive parametric spec database for CPUs/SoCs. Maker-relevant board lines (Galileo/Edison/Joule, NUC) are discontinued or sold to ASUS (NUC). Movidius/Myriad VPU and Arc GPUs exist but minimal board/module channel. Some FPGA/eval kits on Mouser via Altera.
manufacturers.best_ingest_path: ARK for CPU/SoC specs (reference); Mouser for any Altera/FPGA eval kits. Limited board/module relevance — scope to AI-edge (Movidius) + eval kits only.

manufacturers.catalog_source: https://www.mediatek.com/products (product families); Genio IoT dev boards at https://www.mediatek.com/products/iot

Product pages are spec/marketing, not a parts catalog.
manufacturers.best_ingest_path: Scrape mediatek.com Genio/IoT product pages for EVK metadata (reference). No clean distribution parts feed; Genio EVKs sold via partners (ADLINK, etc.). Limited board pool relevance.

manufacturers.best_ingest_path: Mouser pull for MCU/dev-board SKUs (board-relevant: Curiosity, Explorer, SAM-D/E eval, ATmega/SAMD boards); use parametric pages for family-level metadata. Scope to dev boards + common MCUs to stay bounded.

manufacturers.best_ingest_path: Mouser pull for Qwiic/breakout SKUs; supplement via store category scrape + github.com/sparkfun for OSHW board metadata.

manufacturers.best_ingest_path: Scrape https://www.waveshare.com/product/ category tree + per-product wiki pages. Not on Mouser.

manufacturers.best_ingest_path: Scrape orangepi.org hardware board index + per-board download pages. Not on Mouser.

manufacturers.access_notes: Public, no login for browsing. ADI organizes sensors under product-category pages with parametric selection tables, e.g. IMUs: https://www.analog.com/en/product-category/inertial-measurement-units.html ; accelerometers: https://www.analog.com/en/product-category/mems-accelerometers.html ; gyroscopes; temperature sensors: https://www.analog.com/en/product-category/temperature-sensors.html ; optical/ToF; current/power monitors. ADI also publishes static Product Selection Guide PDFs (e.g. MEMS Inertial Sensors selection tables: https://www.analog.com/media/en/news-marketing-collateral/product-selection-guide/mems_inertial_sensors_selection_tables.pdf) that are clean, parseable tables. Maxim Integrated parts are folded into analog.com (maximintegrated.com redirects); some legacy Maxim SKUs still surface better under the 'Maxim' manufacturer name at distributors. No open public bulk product API; interactive parametric tables have export. Datasheets are open PDFs.
manufacturers.approx_products: 500-1000+ sensor SKUs across ADI+Maxim (IMUs/iSensor, MEMS accelerometers & gyros, temperature, optical/ToF/photometric, current & power monitors, magnetic, pressure, gas/chemical, ultrasonic)
manufacturers.best_ingest_path: Mouser Product Search API, keyword 'Analog Devices <category>' AND 'Maxim Integrated <category>' (IMU, accelerometer, gyroscope, temperature sensor, current sensor, optical sensor, Hall sensor). Authoritative: parse the ADI Product Selection Guide PDFs (clean tables) and/or export analog.com parametric tables to CSV; Octopart/Nexar manufacturer=Analog Devices + Maxim Integrated category filter. Distributor alt: Mouser/DigiKey manufacturer filter.

manufacturers.access_notes: Public, no login for browsing. Each sensor sub-family has a parametric '/products.html' listing with a server-side filterable table, e.g. accelerometers: https://www.st.com/en/mems-and-sensors/accelerometers/products.html ; pressure: https://www.st.com/en/mems-and-sensors/pressure-sensors/products.html ; IMUs: https://www.st.com/en/mems-and-sensors/inemo-inertial-modules/products.html ; temperature: https://www.st.com/en/mems-and-sensors/temperature-sensors/products.html ; ToF/proximity: https://www.st.com/en/mems-and-sensors/proximity-sensors/products.html ; audio MEMS mics: https://www.st.com/en/audio-ics/audio-mems-sensors/products.html . Tables render via an XHR/JSON backend (querycriteria=productId); the HTML tables are Cloudflare/bot-walled for naive scrapers and paginate client-side. No official public bulk CSV/API for the full catalog; the ST parametric tables have a per-table 'Export' (CSV/Excel) button usable interactively. Dev/eval boards live under evaluation-tools (e.g. https://www.st.com/en/evaluation-tools/mems-and-sensors-eval-boards/products.html).
manufacturers.approx_products: 250-400 active MEMS/sensor SKUs (accelerometers, gyros, 6/9-axis IMUs, pressure, temperature, humidity, magnetometers, ToF/proximity, MEMS microphones)
manufacturers.best_ingest_path: Mouser Product Search API, keyword 'STMicroelectronics <category>' (accelerometer, gyroscope, IMU, pressure sensor, temperature sensor, humidity sensor, magnetometer, time of flight, MEMS microphone). For the authoritative ST catalog, interactively export each parametric '/products.html' table to CSV, or pull via Octopart/Nexar GraphQL manufacturer=STMicroelectronics filtered by category. Distributor alt: Mouser/DigiKey manufacturer filter.

manufacturers.access_notes: Public, no login for browsing. TI's sensor landing page links to per-category parametric filter pages, each with 'View all products' tables, e.g. temperature: https://www.ti.com/sensors/temperature-sensors/overview.html ; humidity: https://www.ti.com/sensors/humidity-sensors/overview.html ; current sense: https://www.ti.com/sensing-products/current-sense-amplifiers/overview.html ; magnetic/Hall position: https://www.ti.com/sensors/magnetic-sensors/overview.html ; mmWave radar: https://www.ti.com/sensors/mmwave-radar/overview.html ; inductive/capacitive/ToF proximity. The parametric tables are filterable and have a CSV/Excel export in the interactive 'parametric search' table view. TI does NOT publish an open public product API; order/pricing is behind the TI Store (login for pricing). Tables are JS-rendered (bot-walled for naive fetch). Datasheets are open PDFs at ti.com/lit/pdf/<litnum>.
manufacturers.approx_products: 300-500 sensor SKUs (temperature, humidity, current/power, magnetic & Hall-effect position, inductive/capacitive, ultrasonic & mmWave radar, ambient light, ToF)
manufacturers.best_ingest_path: Mouser Product Search API, keyword 'Texas Instruments <category>' (temperature sensor, humidity sensor, current sensor, Hall effect sensor, magnetic position sensor, mmWave radar, proximity sensor). Authoritative: export each TI parametric sensor table to CSV from ti.com, or Octopart/Nexar manufacturer=Texas Instruments category filter. Distributor alt: Mouser/DigiKey manufacturer filter.

manufacturers.access_notes: Sensor Solutions portfolio: ambient light/color/spectral/proximity (TSL25xxx, TMG49xx, AS73xx spectral), position sensors (magnetic/inductive AS5xxx), ToF, environmental/gas (CCS811/ENS160 via sister lines), bio/health (AS7000). Per-part pages with datasheets. Optical-sensor leader. Full line on DigiKey/Mouser.
manufacturers.best_ingest_path: ams-osram sensor category pages for PNs; Mouser keyword pull 'ams OSRAM ambient light' / 'AS5600' / 'ams spectral'.

manufacturers.access_notes: Category-based listing: Electronic Compass (AK0991x series), Tri-axis Magnetic Sensor (AK0997x), Hall Elements, Hall ICs, Current Sensors, Angle sensors. Each lineup page lists parts with datasheets. Magnetic-sensor specialist. Full line on DigiKey/Mouser.
manufacturers.best_ingest_path: AKM lineup pages for PNs; Mouser/DigiKey AKM supplier filter; keyword pull 'AKM magnetic sensor' / 'AK099'.

manufacturers.access_notes: Products grouped into Motion Sensors & IMUs, Environmental Sensors (BME280/BME680/BME690 pressure+humidity+gas, BMP390 pressure), Smart Sensors. Each part has its own page with datasheet download. No public parametric API/CSV; listing is small and categorized. Full line also mirrored on Mouser/DigiKey for programmatic pull.
manufacturers.best_ingest_path: Scrape category pages for part numbers, then Mouser keyword pull 'Bosch Sensortec' per sensor type (accelerometer, IMU, pressure, environmental, gas).

manufacturers.access_notes: CEVA is primarily a sensor-fusion IP/software (MotionEngine, SH-2 firmware) + a few SiP modules: BNO08x family (BNO080/085/086 9-axis SiP), FSM30x AHRS/IMU modules. Hardware parts sold via Mouser/DigiKey (and SparkFun/Adafruit breakouts). Only a handful of physical SKUs; the rest is licensable IP. NOTE: BNO055 is Bosch, BNO08x is CEVA/Hillcrest - do not conflate.
manufacturers.best_ingest_path: Mouser/DigiKey keyword pull 'CEVA BNO080' / 'Hillcrest FSM300'; product briefs (ceva-ip.com) for specs. Few SKUs - low ingest priority.

manufacturers.access_notes: Products page has category selectors: magnetic position sensor ICs (Triaxis MLX90363/90364/90393), Hall latches/switches (MLX92xxx), linear Hall (MLX91377), current sensors, temperature (MLX90614 IR, MLX90632), ToF, pressure, optical. Per-part pages with datasheets. Automotive-grade focus. Full line on Mouser/DigiKey.
manufacturers.best_ingest_path: Melexis product category pages for PNs; Mouser keyword pull 'Melexis hall' / 'Melexis MLX90614' / 'Melexis position'.

manufacturers.best_ingest_path: MEMSIC category pages for PNs; Mouser keyword pull 'MEMSIC accelerometer' / 'MEMSIC MXC'; LCSC fallback for China-only parts.
